lessonRecap.stringValue: A place name helps locate an event. Joining requires evidence about people and actions. A resident, participant and affected person are not always the same role. The Bohol uprising is dated 1621. The Bohol movement is dated 1744-1829. A shared place does not make separate movements one event. The marker links Palapag and 1 June 1649. It names spread into areas of the Visayas, Mindanao and Luzon. Reported spread is not proof that every resident joined or every local action was identical. Gabriela continued the Ilocos uprising after Diego. The named contribution belongs to an Ilocos case. A leader account is not a complete record of regional participation. Keep case, place, period and recorded action together. Different sources can supply different kinds of participation evidence. Missing detail is not proof that a community was unimportant.

question.stringValue: What connected work and places made the galleon trade a network?

task.stringValue: A route map and a work record describe the trade. Why compare them?

introduction.stringValue: What connected work and places made the galleon trade a network? A trading network includes routes, goods and labour, with different effects for different people. It is more than a line between ports.

lessonRecap.stringValue: A connection across the Pacific, not every exact sailing track. A schematic link is not the exact sailing track of every voyage. Its loading port, not necessarily its place of manufacture. Examples do not establish every ships complete cargo or successful delivery. The account may leave workers unnamed; it does not prove they did no work. A merchant account may not name everyone who contributed. The outcome of that same voyage. One outcome does not establish the result of every crossing. Evidence about different peoples receipts, costs and choices. Ending this route did not end all Philippine trade.
